prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Korean woman — the personification of Busan — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Busan as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Busan with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: her living room with a deep sofa, floor cushions and a low table
Season: spring — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street; low gold light through the window, long warm stripes across the walls.
Light direction: two-colour light — warm indoor light on one side, cool daylight or dusk on the other.
Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of Mature from The King of Fighters 2002 — the costume's recognisable colours and parts, cut as a high-cut bodysuit with sheer thigh-high stockings, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: reclining on her back.
SUPPORT: the lounger supports her back and head.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the right of the frame; head turned with her body, the tip of her nose pointing toward the right of the frame; camera slightly above, looking down at her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right arm bends behind her head, the hand cradling the back of her head, her elbow raised beside her head.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with her own left hand she holds a self-heating tumbler with a glowing band at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: legs stretched out long.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere.

Costume: her outfit itself shows that game character — the costume's recognisable colours, shapes and parts at first glance, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit. She is a real woman wearing a cosplay of that character, not the character: her face, hair colour and body stay exactly as in the attached image — never the character's face, body, creature shape, logo or readable text. Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, armour or regalia from it; only the costume's own pieces.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

observations: 검정과 흰색 바디수트 코스프레로 거실 소파에 기대 있고, 왼손에는 머그형 텀블러가 있다.
비대칭 남색 단발을 유지하고 한 팔은 머리를 받치며 전신과 배경이 함께 보인다.
